prompt: Who is the most recent recipient of a Nobel Prize in one of the sciences who held Asian citizenship at the time of the award?
answer: The most recent such recipients were **Susumu Kitagawa (Japanese)** and **Omar M. Yaghi (Jordanian-American)**, who jointly received the **2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry**. **Shimon Sakaguchi**, a Japanese citizen, also received the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
